fullContentHtml:
Bihar Library Eligibility Test BLET Dummy Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released the Dummy Admit Card for the Bihar School Library Eligibility Test BSLET Examination 2026. The online application process for Bihar Library Eligibility Test BLET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 01 October 2026, to 31 October 2026. The Examination is going to conducted 19 November to 10 December 2026. Candidates must download their Bihar Library Eligibility Test BLET Dummy Admit Card 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01 October 2026
  • Last Date : 31 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 October 2026
  • Dummy Admit Card : 02 – 05 November 2026
  • Exam Date : 19 November 2026 to 10 December 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, BC : Rs. 960/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 760/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Download Dummy Admit Card
  • Check Dummy Admit Card Notice
  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Bihar Library Eligibility Test BLET Dummy Admit Card 2026?

Bihar Library Eligibility Test BLET Dummy Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
